text: {"facts":[{"statement":"The task is to count contiguous text windows whose length equals the pattern length and whose letters can be rearranged to match the pattern; each '?' in the pattern can match any lowercase letter.","source_ids":["task"]},{"statement":"Input consists of the text on the first line and the pattern on the second line; output is one integer. Both lengths are between 1 and 200000, and the required program is Python 3.11 using only the standard library.","source_ids":["task"]},{"statement":"If the pattern is longer than the text, the required output is 0.","source_ids":["task"]},{"statement":"The example inputs `a` / `aa` and `accaab` / `aaabac` both have output 0.","source_ids":["public1","public2"]}],"open_requirements":["Return a complete Python 3.11 program that reads stdin and writes the count to stdout."],"tentative_options":[{"id":"sliding-frequency","method":"Maintain character-frequency counts for the current window and compare them with the pattern's literal-character requirements; a window is valid if it contains at least each required count.","unverified_assumptions":["Checking all 26 lowercase-letter counts per window is acceptable for the stated input limits."]},{"id":"sliding-deficits","method":"Slide a fixed-length window while maintaining how many literal pattern characters are still missing; count a window when no literal requirements are missing, with remaining positions matched by wildcards.","unverified_assumptions":["The deficit updates can be implemented without errors when characters enter and leave the window."]}],"possible_checks":["Verify both supplied examples produce 0.","Check patterns with all wildcards, no wildcards, and mixed literals and wildcards against manually enumerated windows.","Check a pattern longer than the text and inputs near the maximum lengths."]}
